decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.0%) with no clear directional signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below our $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a neutral tape — waiting for a genuine risk-on setup to fill the 3 open slots.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with the NASDAQ dipping 0.2% and the S&P 500 roughly flat. There was no dominant macro catalyst driving the session, reflecting a market in a holding pattern rather than a clear risk-on or risk-off move. Without a strong signal, institutional flows appear balanced between buyers and sellers.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅整理，納指微跌0.2%，標普500幾乎收平。市場缺乏明顯的宏觀催化劑，反映投資者處於觀望狀態，並非明確的風險偏好或避險情緒主導。在缺乏強烈訊號下，機構資金的買賣力量大致平衡。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash in reserve instead of investing it immediately. When the market gives no strong signal, holding cash — even if it means missing a slow day — lets you deploy it with more confidence when a real opportunity appears.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「彈藥」（Dry Powder）是指保留現金儲備而非立即全數投入市場。當市場缺乏明確訊號時，持有現金——即使因此錯過平淡的一天——能讓你在真正機會出現時更有信心地部署資金。
